body.statement: Determine from the primitive H\"older--margin geometry an explicit piecewise function of \((T,\rho,\beta,\alpha,d,\delta)\) and prove that both \(W_{T,\delta}(\rho;\mathcal P_{\beta,\alpha}^{\mathrm{HM}})\) and \(\Omega_{T,\delta}(\rho;\mathcal P_{\beta,\alpha}^{\mathrm{HM}})\) are equivalent to it up to constants throughout the feasible regime.  The derivation must evaluate the corrected baseline-indexed occupation relaxation, locate every budget branch and flattening threshold, and prove that one law-independent predictable design and one connected honest interval attain the upper side.  It must recover the proved \(\rho^{-1/2}\) fixed-gap edge, recover the fixed-design offline honest-width order when \(\rho\asymp T\), and settle the Gaussian early-kill case \(d=1\), \(\beta=1\), \(\alpha=1/5\), and \(\rho\asymp T^{3/5}\).  No rate, saturation property, strong-duality identity, or realization claim is assumed.
body.justification: The explicit rate and every transition remain outputs; the corrected implicit obstruction is now rigorous but unevaluated.
body.gap: Prior work does not match an all-design nonregular honest-width converse with a welfare-budgeted continuous-context adaptive construction.
body.consumer: The completed frontier would translate a participant-welfare budget into the shortest uniformly credible interval for targeting gain.

obligation.what_is_open: Evaluate \(w_{T,\rho}\) from H\"older--margin geometry, derive every local branch and flattening threshold, and construct one budget-feasible adaptive design with a connected honest interval attaining the resulting full-class width.
obligation.obstruction: The corrected program gives a necessary baselinewise relaxation, but its law-specific feasible profiles are not yet jointly realizable. The frozen bump lemma does not by itself evaluate the occupation program or construct the nonsmooth positive-part interval, so an explicit upper rate would still assume the central exploration-and-inference step.
obligation.attempted: Combined the established feasibility boundary, coverage converse, fixed-gap frontier, and bump family with the corrected occupation formulation. The new design-embedding lemma yields an implicit procedure-free lower bound, but no honest derivation converts it into a closed H\"older exponent or matching estimator.
obligation.partial_result: The proved bracket is \(\max\{w_{T,\rho},c\rho^{-1/2}\}\le W_{T,\delta}\le2M\) under the stated fixed-gap interior compatibility and \(C_1\log T\le\rho\le c_1T\), while \(w_{T,\rho}\le W_{T,\delta}\le2M\) throughout the feasible regime.  Below feasibility \(W_{T,\delta}=+\infty\), and the early-kill fixed-gap term is \(T^{-3/10}\).  The value of \(w_{T,\rho}\) and an attaining full-class construction remain open.
